BioIntel Demo
Inflammation reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 6. The compound infliximab was discussed with target TNF in the context of rheumatoid arthritis. The example mutation is G308A. A demonstration EC50 measurement of 463 nM is shown for Homo sapiens. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0006 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0006.
